questions.question: What does David lament has vanished in Psalm 12?
options: The godly and the faithful among the children of man
The poor and the needy who cry out aloud for help
The priests who faithfully serve in the holy temple courts
The exiles who are scattered among all the nations
questions.answer: The godly and the faithful among the children of man

questions.question: To what are the words of the LORD compared?
options: Honey that is far sweeter than the dripping honeycomb
Silver refined in a furnace, purified seven times
A shining lamp that lights the path in the dark
A flowing spring of fresh and clear living water
questions.answer: Silver refined in a furnace, purified seven times

questions.question: David says people speak lies and flattery with a double heart.
